quotes.text: The paragraph should be the label for the select otherwise this is not accessible.
Having a single element container allows you to hide/show it more easily without needing to loop through all the element IDs.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In the HTML expiry dialog, bind the select to a real label. Use HTML layout, such as a CSS grid, for key properties instead of XUL boxes. Wrap optional details in one container and toggle it as a unit. Check simple and complex mode after layout changes. In this dialog, showing details initially then hiding for simple mode was accepted because adding them dynamically could push OK/Cancel beyond the initial window size. Do not turn hidden-by-default into a universal rule.
title: Use semantic HTML labels and one container for conditional key details
